name: Chemistry
author: Simitone
description: Turn-ons, turn-offs and chemistry, after The Sims 2: Nightlife. Each grown Sim has two turn-ons and a turn-off, and how much a social raises how one Sim feels about another depends on the chemistry between them: half as much for a Sim who is turned off, up to twice as much at three bolts. Changes the game's balance. A first stage, not yet run against a game. Console: chemistry help
